I am a woman with no schooling, farming less than one hectare of maize here in Mangochi to feed my children. If I am lucky enough to get the FISP coupon this year, I will use that small bag of NPK and urea on my maize, but I cannot afford to buy more at the market. I keep some seed from last year and mix in a little chompho from the kraal where I can. I do most of the work myself with the hand hoe, and only ask for ganyu help during weeding if my back is bad.
